footnotes_as_printed.a: Total pressure adjusted with helium in order to allow convenient sampling.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Repeatability of sequential analyses of the aqueous phase.

pressure_note: Pexp = experimental total pressure of the VLLE system (Pt-Druck transducer, 0-0.3 MPa transducer calibrated against dead-weight balance); the hydrocarbon partial pressure is computed afterwards as P - Pw (paper, eq 3-4). Pressure adjusted with helium (footnote a).

repeatability.what: repeatability of sequential analyses of the aqueous phase (not the total uncertainty)

extra_unmapped: xcal nC4 x 10^5 (calculated by authors, eq 10, derived_by_authors)
notes: Solubility of the hydrocarbon in the water-rich liquid phase under three-phase (vapour-liquid-liquid) conditions, static-analytic method with Rolsi sampler, GC (TCD for water, FID for hydrocarbon). Pexp is the total system pressure. xcal and rel dev are calculated by the authors from their Henry-law correlation (eq 10) and are kept in the CSV unmapped. Salt-free (pure water); mole fraction in the aqueous phase, basis (water-free or total) not stated explicitly. Header-level footnote letters are repeated in the note column on every row; a letter glued to a number is recorded on that row only. Rows 0-1 (298.29 and 303.31 K) carry footnote a (helium-adjusted pressure, printed 0.5311a and 0.5669a); the other rows carry no footnote a and their pressures coincide with the three-phase pressures of Table 3 (313.24 K: 0.3868 vs 0.3934 MPa at 313.21 K in Table 3).
regime_note: Hydrocarbon-rich liquid phase assumed present (title: VLLE conditions); hydrocarbon is liquid at these T and P.
mapping_fix: uncertainty column (delta_x) is the repeatability of sequential analyses, not the uncertainty (paper: 1-2.5 % on mole numbers); not stored (audit 2026-10-02)
